content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone advise if it is possible to connect a type K thermocouple to [product_name]? Thank you, [user_name]
[product_name] cannot process thermocouple signals. You should use an external converter that outputs 0-10V or 0/4-20 mA.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wanted to connect a type K thermocouple to [product_name] but was advised that direct connection is not possible, as the hardware cannot process thermocouple signals without an external converter. This demonstrates a limitation in compatibility for direct thermocouple inputs.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects [product_name] to support direct input from a type K thermocouple without requiring additional hardware.
